headline: Dollar starts the week near 49 lira - ensonhaber.com
summary: The dollar is trading at 48.80 lira in global markets, driven by expectations about Federal Reserve monetary policy. Markets are focused on statements from Fed officials this week.
why: The lira-dollar exchange rate reflects Turkish currency value and is closely watched by importers, exporters and foreign investors in Turkey.
